summary: Adopt immutable Policy DSL runtime for CONTRIBUTING

delivery.outcome: Make reviewed Policy DSL an immutable managed dependency of new-project and automatically validate every adopted repository CONTRIBUTING.md through the pinned inert runtime
nonGoals: Do not execute Policy DSL actions or grant authority from validation
Do not fetch a mutable branch or use network access during repository validation
Do not treat the current unreviewed Policy DSL pull request as a published dependency
Do not validate unrelated Markdown or shell example fences as policy

architecture.decision: Vendor the exact reviewed dependency-free Policy DSL checker into the managed governance package, bind its upstream repository revision and SHA-256 in a closed lock, verify the lock before use, and invoke it fail-closed whenever CONTRIBUTING.md exists
interfaceChanges: The governance gate validates CONTRIBUTING.md with Policy DSL when that file exists
scripts/runtime.sh policy performs Policy DSL conformance before policy evaluation
The adoption package installs the checker and its immutable upstream lock
dataChanges: Add a closed policy dependency lock binding repository, reviewed revision, runtime path and SHA-256
Normalize the legacy policy-shaped Bash fence in CONTRIBUTING.md to the canonical dsl selector
architecture.rollback: Before release revert ticket-080; after release preserve the pin and publish an explicit standard upgrade with a new reviewed Policy DSL revision

commands: python3 scripts/governance_check.py --root . --manifest governance/manifest.hub.json --stack-profiles governance/stack-profiles.json --work-classification governance/work-classification.dsl.json --base main --head HEAD --actor agent --format text
